title: Toolbox
subtitle: Lightweight media utilities for audio, video, and subtitle workflows, processed 100% locally.
dropFilesHere: Drag and drop files here, or click to browse

subtitle-converter.name: Subtitle Format & Encoding Converter
subtitle-converter.desc: Convert between SRT, VTT, ASS, LRC, TXT, auto-detect & fix ANSI/GBK encoding, and convert Traditional/Simplified Chinese

video-trimmer.name: Lossless Video Trimmer
video-trimmer.desc: Millisecond-precise dual-handle trimmer with stream-copy export in seconds, with seamless handoff to transcription

audio-extractor.name: Fast Audio Extractor & Converter
audio-extractor.desc: Extract audio tracks to MP3, WAV, AAC, or FLAC, with preset 16kHz standard voice format for ASR

embedded-subtitles.name: Embedded Subtitle Extractor
embedded-subtitles.desc: Quickly inspect MKV/MP4 embedded text subtitle tracks and extract selected streams to separate files

subtitle-sync.name: Subtitle Time Shifter & Sync
subtitle-sync.desc: Shift timecodes globally, stretch/compress by frame rate ratio, or calibrate via two-point linear interpolation

bilingual-subtitles.name: Bilingual Subtitle Merger & Splitter
bilingual-subtitles.desc: Merge two monolingual subtitle files by overlapping timestamps or split bilingual subtitles into separate files

video-compressor.name: Quick Video Compressor
video-compressor.desc: Easily reduce video file size with presets for WeChat (<25MB) or standard 1080p/720p sharing

video-to-gif.name: Video to High-Quality GIF
video-to-gif.desc: Clip video segments into crisp, noise-free GIFs using two-pass palette generation

videoTrimmer.modeLosslessDesc: Direct stream copy, 100% original quality and container, keyframe aligned, takes seconds (Recommended)
videoTrimmer.modeAccurateDesc: Frame-by-frame decode and re-encode, strict frame-accurate alignment, takes longer
videoTrimmer.shortcutTip: Tips: Drag [ ] handles to set clip boundaries; click [-1s][-0.1s][+0.1s][+1s] to fine-tune; [ for In point, ] for Out point, Space to play/pause, Left/Right to step frames

audioExtractor.batchTip: Supports batch extraction from multiple videos

embeddedSubtitles.noSubtitlesFound: No embedded text subtitle tracks found in this video

bilingualSubtitles.actionMerge: Merge Two Monolingual Subtitles into Bilingual
bilingualSubtitles.actionSplit: Split Bilingual Subtitle into Two Monolingual Files
bilingualSubtitles.posTop: Primary on Top, Secondary on Bottom
bilingualSubtitles.posBottom: Primary on Bottom, Secondary on Top

videoToGif.highQualityNotice: Uses two-pass PaletteGen algorithm for vibrant, artifact-free GIFs
